name: [NEW UPDATE!] SURVIVE FOLK VALLEY HOTEL
desc:
Welcome to SURVIVE FOLK VALLEY HOTEL

RESTART = UPDATE

Hide from monsters and collect eyes to complete the Round. Grab your friends and work together to defeat the monsters that Arrive when night strikes, Beware as each round buffs the monsters speed and power.
When the player survives the round, you will gain coins for surviving the night. If you die and survive after, you will get coins but not as much. 
Use coins to buy gears and defeat the monsters. defeating a monster gives a huge reward of coins to players.

Current Monsters in game ( 9 )

(⚠️WARNING⚠️)
This game is in testing phase for right now , so if players experience bugs please report them in our server down below. 
During This phase players who played during testers/people who played on release will be rewarded with a title and maybe some other gifts. 

Thank you for playing and most of all have fun!
